evidence.detail: Exact v308 builds root 42100 and preserves the title '<img=131> Coffer of Unclaimed Rewards & Prizes <img=131>'.

The interface owns bank-style inventory storage plus Remove 1/5/10/All controls, deposit-to-inventory/bank actions and exact explanatory text that the coffer holds contest prizes and event rewards, especially when received while offline.
The class is a dedicated interface builder/presentation surface for unclaimed reward/prize storage; no unrelated mail or ordinary bank service behavior is inferred.
